verdict.rationale: Honcho documents storing conversation messages and querying them later through search results, session context, and peer representations (honcho-gh-1, honcho-docs-2). Its SDKs are positioned for adding memory (honcho-gh-3), and it is described as a persistent memory layer whose context carries across sessions and tools (honcho-docs-1, honcho-docs-18, honcho-probe-1). missing for 10: explicit documentation that search is semantic/vector-based, detailed search API docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of recall quality.
